results.observation: Across two existing four-seed batches and three fixed projections, train-only 16-D orthogonal tracking of a frozen cue6 decoder beats latest-cue and shuffled-label controls in all within-order cells through delay8, but only 12/24 at delay32 and 0/24 at delay64. results.interpretation: A bounded offline coordinate correction is adequate at short within-order delays and inadequate as a robust late or cross-order coordinate system. External dynamic-readout feasibility is not evidence that Demian adapts or self-decodes.

results.observation: Train-only low-capacity frozen probes transferred to one unseen six-event reliability order (mean projected-state R² 0.242; median cell R² 0.449; median Pearson r 0.721), but did not meet the preregistered seed-robust criterion. Frozen six-to-eight-event transfer failed, with large negative R² caused by a major length-conditioned state baseline and scale shift outside the six-event standardization range.
results.interpretation: The fixed finite system supports some low-capacity order transfer at six events, but no calibrated frozen transfer across the tested history length. The length result does not determine whether target-related rank information remains after the length shift.
